scope: All 10 taxonomy cases after the phone table presentation follow-up
change: Readable minimum table width, a labelled focusable horizontal-scroll region and a visible scrolling hint; mutation logic unchanged

tests.title: taxonomy requires editor/admin page and data permission, including write attempts
editor creates, renames, archives and reactivates a category while its slug remains immutable
tag creation reports normalized-name and immutable-slug duplicates while retaining the proposal
archiving used vocabulary preserves published and historical references and requires active replacement before resubmission
stale taxonomy version keeps the proposal and requires explicit comparison and a newly confirmed version
lost taxonomy create response retries identical captured input and key without duplicate creation
uncertain taxonomy action stops after the replay window and resolves by authorized current-state review
a late taxonomy selection cannot replace an entry with an in-flight or uncertain saved change
managed taxonomy traverses every server page and keeps active and archived filters distinct
taxonomy keyboard confirmation, focus restoration, phone reflow and both themes pass axe

verification: Includes real lifecycle, conflict, retry, pagination and archive-reference cases, axe in both themes at 1440/390/320px, no document overflow, and native ArrowRight scrolling on focused phone table regions
limitations: The full 315-test regression run precedes this presentation-only follow-up; its actual build provenance is retained separately
Native Android, real Google-provider and release gates remain pending
